name: Keep Tryin'
source:
It's her day off, but how will she spend it? Help Saem figure it out in this slice of life/otome/visual novel..thing.

[From [url=https://lehxra.itch.io/keep-tryin]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
今天她放假，可要怎麼過呢？來這個日常向／乙女／視覺小說……之類的玩意兒裡，幫Saem拿拿主意吧。

［摘自[url=https://lehxra.itch.io/keep-tryin]itch.io[/url]］
